lessons_used: Predictions were mostly too high compared to actual noise-corrected results, except for sign_in notification where the prediction was too low.
No clear effect was seen for home new_flow changes across 2 tests.
No clear effect was seen for sign_in reorder changes across 2 tests.
Adoption redesign changes showed no clear effect in 2 tests and made performance worse in 2 tests.
Finish new_screen changes made finish worse in 1 test and showed no clear effect in 1 test across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_flow, choose_path reorder, and sign_in notification, as each has only 1 test.

candidates.title: Story Screen Split Layout
candidates.change: Reconstruct the story introductory screen into a split layout to present story lore on one side and immediate path selection on the other.
candidates.why: Choose_path has a 23.8% drop rate with a high mean time of 514s vs 8s median, indicating story screen friction before choosing a path.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Companion
story.body: Choose how you want your pet to live on your desktop.

guard.reason: Redesigning story screen layout and text within onboarding is allowed and maintains all required screen functions.

candidates.score_note: High mean completion time suggests hesitation, but layout changes lack direct email evidence.

candidates.title: Sign In Desktop Sync Assurance Notification
candidates.change: Add an automated readiness notification on the sign-in screen reassuring users that desktop pet data will sync immediately upon login.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Your desktop pet, memory, and settings sync securely across sign-ins.

guard.reason: Adding a sync assurance hint to sign_in is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Strong support email evidence (8 complaints) and sign_in notifications showed strong positive lift (+8%) in previous tests.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Lighting Guidance Hint
candidates.change: Add a photo lighting guidance hint with tip delay on the upload_photos screen.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, contributing to the 39.1% drop at adoption stage.

upload_photos.hint: For best custom pet accuracy, upload clear, well-lit photos without heavy shadows.

guard.reason: Adding photo lighting guidance to upload_photos is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has highest drop rate (39.1%) and 3 support emails; simple hint avoids complex redesign pitfalls.

candidates.title: Waiting Stage Companion Care Tips
candidates.change: Display time estimate and a tip carousel component on the waiting screen during pet rendering.
candidates.why: The waiting step (home) has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, creating drop-off risk while waiting.

components.label: Tip: Your pet will react to your mouse movement and sound on the desktop.

guard.reason: 'waiting.components[0].label' must be text up to 40 characters

candidates.title: Home Intro Command Hub Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the home_intro welcome screen using component replace to explicitly display mascot guidance and right-click control instructions.
candidates.why: 3 support emails mentioned confusion on how to control or hide pets, and finish conversion drops 35.2%.

home_welcome.text: Right-click your pet at any time on your desktop to open controls, talk, or hide.

guard.reason: Redesigning home_intro controls guidance with components is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish stage drops 35.2% with 3 emails, but redesigns consistently showed negative or neutral lift in past tests.

candidates.title: Path Decision Companion Preview Screen
candidates.change: Add a new screen 'new_path_preview' between story and choose_path to show interactive previews of companion path choices.
candidates.why: 23.8% drop off occurs at choose_path, and mean time (514s) points to hesitation without seeing path outcomes.

new_path_preview.headline: Preview Your Companion Experience
new_path_preview.body: Explore how each companion path changes how your pet behaves on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adding a path preview screen inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Adding new screens tends to increase step friction, and evidence relies only on funnel mean time.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Name First Reorder
candidates.change: Reorder adoption screens so adoption_certificate comes directly after pick_friend and before upload_photos.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is only 60.9% with 1017s mean time; naming the pet first builds commitment before photo uploading.

guard.reason: existing screens must keep their order; only sign_in may move

candidates.title: Finish Stage Desktop Dock Tutorial Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a new screen 'new_desktop_dock_intro' in the finish step with a checklist layout covering tray controls and desktop overlay behavior.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails cited post-onboarding confusion regarding hiding pets and desktop overlay misbehavior.

new_desktop_dock_intro.headline: Desktop Dock & Controls Overview
new_desktop_dock_intro.body: Learn how to toggle pet visibility, dock to system tray, and access quick commands.

guard.reason: Adding a new tutorial screen after home_intro is explicitly allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: New tutorial flows historically hurt conversion across multiple test types despite support complaints.

candidates.title: Sign In Existing Pet Recovery Copy
candidates.change: Update the headline and body copy on sign_in to assure returning users their pet progress and account state will be restored.
candidates.why: Top support theme (8 emails) concerns lost or reset pets upon signing back in.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Restore & Sync Your Pet
sign_in.body: Signing in secures your companion's memory, customization, and settings across sessions.

guard.reason: Updating sign_in copy to mention pet sync and recovery is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Directly addresses top support concern (8 emails) with low-cost copy change on a sign_in step.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Companion Trait Badge Incentive
candidates.change: Add a highlight trait badge component to the pick_friend screen emphasizing unique pet desktop animations.
candidates.why: Adoption suffers from a 39.1% drop rate and high mean completion time.

guard.reason: Adding feature badges on pick_friend without mentioning pricing or unfair incentives is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Targets largest drop step (39.1%), but lacks direct support email evidence for trait badges.

lessons_next: Predictions were mostly too high for neutral or negative changes, but too low for winning tests (sign_in notification and adoption new_flow).

No clear effect was seen for sign_in reorder changes across 2 tests.
Adoption redesign changes showed no clear effect in 2 tests and made performance worse in 2 tests.
Finish new_screen changes made finish worse in 1 test and showed no clear effect in 1 test.
